title: Bayern and Inter win away as the Champions League's fourth round opens
summary: Bayern Munich won 2-0 at Atletico Madrid through Lennart Karl and Konrad Laimer, Barcelona beat Aston Villa 3-0 with two Raphinha goals, and Inter won 3-0 at Feyenoord on a night of away wins. LASK routed Slovan Bratislava 4-0, Galatasaray beat Stuttgart 2-0 and Sporting won 1-0 at Shakhtar Donetsk. Bodo/Glimt and Lille drew 0-0, while Manchester United and Paris Saint-Germain completed the visitors' sweep.
